description: Expanding an unknown tuple makes the result the dynamic value without evaluating it
notes: The spec doesn't say how an unknown value expands (see native/unknowns/function-expand-unknown-tuple). hashicorp/hcl returns the dynamic value for an expanded argument that is unknown, before mapping the arguments to parameters (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), so the function isn't called and its result isn't evaluated.
